# Cloakroom

> A privacy layer for Claude Code. A plugin with hooks swaps names, emails, addresses, API keys and IDs in tool output for placeholders (PII_PERSON_1, PII_SECRET_1) before the model sees them, and puts the real values back when Claude writes files or runs commands, on the user's machine. Detection is a local model (PII-Tracer) plus rules; nothing is sent anywhere. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux. Apache-2.0.

Install: `/plugin marketplace add shanjeevrajendran/cloakroom`, then `/plugin install cloakroom@cloakroom`. The plugin installs the Python package (`cloakroom` on PyPI) itself on first start. Prompts that contain a secret are blocked (Claude Code hooks cannot rewrite a prompt); `cr!` sends one anyway, `cr: pause 10m` / `cr: resume` pause and resume checks.
